canonical_project: Oman Australia Cable Cocos (Keeling) Islands cable landing station modular facility
notes: DXN announced a contract to deliver cable landing station modules for the Oman Australia Cable, including a Cocos (Keeling) Islands landing-station facility; SUBCO press material places the OAC route through Cocos and later trade reporting says OAC is live. Treat as a telecom/edge modular facility rather than a known hyperscale or colocation compute campus; MW capacity not disclosed.
